purpose: A table's data source is captured by the iteration that is accepted, not by a Newton iterate the solver discards.

oracle.derivation: VAMS-2023 9.21.1 captures on the first call and 9.3 forbids a rejected iteration's side effects; VerA keeps a capture only from an accepted iteration (VD-095). At the solution V the rows are (0,V),(1,V+2), so lookup at 0.5 is V+1 and I=V-0.5(V+1)=0 gives V(out)=1. A capture fixed at the zero iterate (lookup 1) would give 0.5. The captured rows carry no derivative, so each Newton iterate halves the error and stops once its step is under reltol (1e-3 at 1 V): atol 2e-3.
